content.text: Nothing else is on your day. 90% chance of rain today, so I'd go with the indoor option. Riverbend Community Centre has Indoor open play gym, Saturdays 9 a.m. to noon, for ages 1 to 5, $6 per child, per their program page. [link-187000] It's 9:30 now, so you'd catch most of it. Check their page before you head out, since I haven't confirmed it myself.
